name: greenfield
description: New software projects starting from scratch. Emphasizes architecture decisions, initial setup, and scaffolding.

custom.name: architecture
custom.description: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), system diagrams, component relationships, data flow, and design patterns catalog

custom.name: conventions
custom.description: Coding standards including naming conventions, file organization, error handling patterns, and formatting rules

custom.name: documentation
custom.description: Documentation strategy covering doc location, audience, format standards, generation tools, mathematical derivations, ASCII diagrams, sample images (plotly/matplotlib), code examples, mermaid flowcharts, and validation cases

workflowEmphasis: Focus on establishing solid architectural foundations
Document technology choices and their rationale
Set up comprehensive documentation from day one
guidance.documentationFocus: Architecture decisions, technology rationale, project scaffolding, and comprehensive inline + external documentation with rich examples
keyConsiderations: What frameworks and libraries best fit the requirements?
How should the codebase be organized?
What development patterns should be established?
Are there performance or scalability requirements to consider upfront?
What testing strategy should be adopted from the start?
How will documentation be generated and maintained?
What validation cases demonstrate the system works correctly?
